details: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have experienced six consecutive days of outflows, totaling approximately $1.55 billion since May 14. This significant institutional de-risking has reduced 2026 net inflows to around $536 million, reflecting cautious sentiment among large investors amidst broader macroeconomic uncertainties and Bitcoin's underperformance this year.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Prolonged Outflows, Nearing Net-Negative for 2026

details: A crypto whale has opened a highly leveraged Ether (ETH) short position exceeding $100 million on Hyperliquid, with its liquidation price just 2% away from the entry. This aggressive bearish bet coincides with Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin's pledge that the Ethereum Foundation will "sell less ETH" to prioritize longevity, a move that comes amid weakening institutional conviction and substantial outflows from spot Ethereum ETFs.
title: Ethereum Whale Shorts $100M ETH; Vitalik Pledges Fewer EF Sales

details: Stablecoin issuer Tether is collaborating with the Georgian government to introduce GELT, a new stablecoin pegged to the Georgian Lari. Operating under the country's updated digital asset regulatory framework, this initiative aims to enhance cross-border payments and digital commerce within Georgia, signifying a notable step for stablecoin integration into national economies.
title: Tether Partners with Georgia to Launch Lari-Pegged Stablecoin GELT

details: Russia's State Duma has passed a significant crypto regulation bill in its first reading. The legislation establishes a licensing framework for crypto market participants and explicitly permits the use of digital assets for cross-border transactions, aiming to provide an alternative for foreign trade amidst sanctions. However, domestic cryptocurrency payments remain prohibited.
title: Russia Advances Crypto Bill, Allows Digital Assets for Cross-Border Trade

details: NEAR Protocol's native token has surged between 50% and 66% this week, reaching a six-month high. This rally is attributed to the growing enthusiasm for AI-themed cryptocurrencies, a major v2.13 network upgrade scheduled for June, and a recent endorsement from BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes, highlighting NEAR as a top-performing altcoin.
title: NEAR Protocol Surges on AI Narrative, Network Upgrade, and Hayes Endorsement

details: According to CryptoQuant analysts, Bitcoin's "Apparent Demand" metric has dropped to approximately -147,000 BTC, marking its lowest level since the beginning of 2026. This indicates a weakening of structural demand, suggesting that sustained price rallies may face challenges without a significant recovery in spot market activity, though historical patterns suggest such periods can offer long-term investment opportunities.
title: Bitcoin Apparent Demand Hits Lowest Level Since Early 2026, Warns CryptoQuant
